diagnosis.not_a_startup_stall: Live instrumentation (lsof connection sampling + opencode debug logs) showed OpenCode connecting to the gateway and the gateway proxying to SELFPI; requests died at exactly ~301.2-301.5s on every cold canonical load (4 observed) while a 289s call survived.
diagnosis.root_cause_G1: undici default headersTimeout=300s on the gateway's global fetch aborts upstream requests whose first token takes >300s (every cold ourmodelselfgenesis load). AbortSignal.timeout(600000) cannot override the dispatcher default. Streaming calls have max_attempts=1, so OpenCode (always streaming) got no retry.
diagnosis.root_cause_G2: On stream-path upstream failure the gateway receipted but answered nothing -> OpenCode held orphaned connections (observed: receipt 12 followed by a still-ESTABLISHED client socket for minutes).
diagnosis.root_cause_G3: Client-abort vs final-chunk race called h.digest() then h.update() -> ERR_CRYPTO_HASH_FINALIZED crashed PID 19646 (server.out.log).
diagnosis.in_flight_bug_found_and_fixed: First node:http rewrite misused req.setTimeout as a connect timeout (socket idle timeout) -> killed header-slow requests at exactly 10s (receipt UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT 10004ms). Corrected to a socket 'connect'-event timer before finalizing.

changes: G1: upstream calls via node:http upstreamPost (explicit UPSTREAM_HEADER_TIMEOUT_MS=600000; no hidden 300s cap); connect timeout bound to socket 'connect' event (10s)
G2: stream-path upstream failure answers SSE-shaped 502 error event so stream clients unblock; non-stream body phase guarded and receipted (UPSTREAM_BODY_FAILED)
G3: hash finalization guard (hashFinalized flag) + truthful transport_note CLIENT_ABORTED_OR_TRUNCATED on truncated streams
